svg.title: Watchman compared with a blood thinner, out of 100 people
svg.desc: Stroke from a clot: Watchman 4, blood thinner 2½ out of 100. Bleeding, not from the procedure: Watchman 4, blood thinner 6½ out of 100. Serious bleeding of any kind: Watchman 8, blood thinner 9½ out of 100. Complication from the procedure: Watchman 3, blood thinner 0 out of 100.
svg.text: Each figure is one person. Colored figures
heart fluid, device moving, stroke, bleeding
